description: This file contains the implementation of the HTML rendering functions, including the Render function that outputs a parse tree to an io.Writer, handling various node types and HTML elements.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the parse tree node n to the provided writer w, attempting to produce HTML output similar to the original tree.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Internal function that calls render1 and handles plaintextAbort error.

methods.name: render1
methods.description: Recursively renders a node and its children to the writer, handling different node types and HTML elements.

methods.name: childTextNodesAreLiteral
methods.description: Determines if child text nodes should be rendered literally based on parent node's data and namespace.

methods.name: writeQuoted
methods.description: Writes a string surrounded by quotes, choosing single or double quotes based on content.
